features.name: Finlathen Park
features.shortDescription: A substantial riverside public park with paths, play and skating facilities; the council’s circular route uses made paths but includes steps.

sourceRecords.licence: Source-linked editorial evidence; check time-sensitive details before travel.

editorialReview.scoreRationale: A useful local park and verified route, but not a journey-making attraction in its own right.

attractionGuide.headline: Use Fintry’s verified riverside green space
attractionGuide.intro: A substantial riverside public park with paths, play and skating facilities; the council’s circular route uses made paths but includes steps.
attractionGuide.parking: Free surface parking is reached from Fountainbleau Drive; capacity and marked accessible bays are not published.
attractionGuide.toilets: No public toilet is documented in the park access guide.
attractionGuide.picnic: Informal park picnicking is possible, but dedicated picnic tables are not verified.
attractionGuide.foodNote: No destination café inside the strict Fintry boundary was verified.

features.name: Fintry and Finlathen circular walk
features.shortDescription: A council-published 1.25-mile / roughly 35-minute circular walk through Fintry and Finlathen Park on generally well-made paths, with some steps.

sourceRecords.sourceName: Fintry and Finlathen circular walk
sourceRecords.licence: Source-linked editorial evidence; check time-sensitive details before travel.
sourceRecords.notes: Current-place curation: trail_score=66; opening_hours:description=Open route; use daylight and current path conditions; entrance_fee=Free; time_to_spend=About 35 minutes; description=1.25-mile Grade 2 circular route with some steps.

editorialReview.scoreRationale: A concise official local circuit with distance, duration, surface and steps documented.
